question.worked_solution:
First, we substitute for $x$ and $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}xy & =(\frac{81{a}^{8}}{{b}^{2}{c}^{3}})\cdot (\frac{{b}^{7}{c}^{11}}{9{a}^{4}}) \\  & =\frac{81{a}^{8}{b}^{7}{c}^{11}}{9{a}^{4}{b}^{2}{c}^{3}}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we separate the fraction, group the three variables separately, and apply the quotient rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{81{a}^{8}{b}^{7}{c}^{11}}{9{a}^{4}{b}^{2}{c}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{81}{9}\cdot \frac{{a}^{8}}{{a}^{4}}\cdot \frac{{b}^{7}}{{b}^{2}}\cdot \frac{{c}^{11}}{{c}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{81}{9}\cdot {a}^{(8-4)}\cdot {b}^{(7-2)}\cdot {c}^{(11-3)} & = \\ 9{a}^{4}{b}^{5}{c}^{8} & \end{aligned}
$$
